operation.description: Operations requested in the visible spreadsheet instruction, before inspecting the workbook. formula_or_macro: asks for or about a formula, function (SUMIFS, INDEX/MATCH, VLOOKUP, IF), VBA, or a macro. lookup_or_join: looks up, matches, joins, or maps values between tables or sheets. date_or_time: involves dates, months, periods, weekdays, workdays, times, or time thresholds. aggregation_or_summary: sums, counts, averages, totals, crosstabs, or summary tables. filter_or_list: filters, extracts, deduplicates, or lists matching records. formatting: changes fills, colors, fonts, borders, alignment, or number formats. schedule_or_calendar: fills a schedule, timetable, rota, or calendar. every_nth_row: takes every nth row, an offset, or a repeating step. residual_balancing: distributes a residual or balances values within min/max constraints. blank_handling: specifies behaviour for blank or empty cells. text_matching: matches text by begins-with, contains, or exact equality, or normalizes names. Several operations may apply; use an empty list if none is recognized.
